title: WPSS/2012/2016 of Kishor Chandra Garkoti AND ANOTHER Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
WPSS No. 2012 of 2016
Hon'ble Rajiv Sharma, J.
Mr. Anil K. Joshi, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. B.P.S. Mer, Brief Holder for the
State.
Mr. Ashish Joshi, Advocate for the
respondent no.2.
Heard.
The petitioner is in feeder category
for promotion to the post of Clerk from
Class IV. Petitioner participated in the
selection process. However, he was not
found eligible. He approached this Court.
He was permitted to sit in the
examination provisionally.
The minimum qualification
prescribed for promotion is intermediate.
Petitioner did not possess the minimum
qualification of intermediate, when the
selection process commenced.
The case of the petitioner is that he
has obtained the intermediate
qualification before the interview.
The qualification is to be seen when
the selection process commenced.
However, in the interest of justice,
the respondents are directed that since
the petitioner has now acquired the
intermediate qualification, his case shall
be considered in accordance with law for
promotion as and when the decision is
taken for making further promotions.
In view of the above, the petition is
disposed of.
Pending application, if any, also
stands disposed of.
